column3: (Cookie No HttpOnly Flag: the sign-in cookie is HttpOnly, ADR 0024)
(Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion: the Console loads its own scripts only, ADR 0031)
(Content-Type Header Missing: every answer names its type)
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing: nosniff on every answer)
(Server Leaks Version Information via the Server header)
(Content Security Policy Header Not Set: every answer carries the policy, ADR 0031)
(Cookie without SameSite Attribute: the sign-in cookie is SameSite=Strict, ADR 0031)
(CSP: the policy allows no inline code, eval or other origin's script, ADR 0031)
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration: the Console answers no cross-origin read)
